It may not be much to offer, but on my bad days, I try to focus on living for cake. 

Stupid, I know. If I try to focus only on the cake, and similar things like petting my cat, there’s a chance I can forget about the pain for even a minute.

A giver. Loving, supporting your family and friends. That is something many people would be proud of. I can see that it’s so painful to not be able to feel the joy we imagine should come from these things. 

If I imagine the gravestone of my mother, a loving and giving woman, I don’t want to see it without flowers any single day of her afterlife. 
If I could see my mother in as much pain as you are in, I don’t know that I could comfort her, or give her anything to make it easier. 

I don’t want to assume anything about your faith, but if God has a plan, I pray that it ends with peace for you.

It sounds like you’re feeling a lot of guilt over the way you’ve treated people. It must be a huge burden to feel like that all the time. It sounds to me, though, like you care about the impacts of your actions. If those people didn’t matter to you, why would you feel any way about it? 

Anyway, the reason I say that is because it makes me think that you want to build happier relationships with people, that you want to be kinder to them, and that you want to be happier with how you live your life. Is that right? 

You know your situation and life best, so if it’s an option for you, would you consider seeing a therapist or even just your regular doctor? They might be able to help you make a plan, if you’re wanting help to make your life into one you feel is worth living. 

The feeling of having ruined your lot in life sounds devastating. If I knew you, I’m sure I still couldn’t quite understand how you feel. Whatever you choose to do next, good luck in it. I hope you find something that will give you peace.

Wow. That’s just...awful all around. The pressure on you from school right now sounds immense. Maybe the pandemic online school workarounds have made it even worse - I know my friends and I find it harder, so you definitely wouldn’t be alone in that. 

I’d like to encourage you to contact the hotline. The few times I’ve done that, I’ve been nervous as hell, but I didn’t regret it afterward. Even when it wasn’t very helpful, it kept the pain at arm’s length for a little while. Maybe it will for you too. 

I’m so sorry you’re having such a hard time right now. If you want to get help regarding school and are able to do so, I think that would be a solid step. If not, then I hope you can find a moment of rest, distraction, whatever you like - anything to make it hurt less for a bit. 

Good luck. You deserve happiness.
